prompt:
Our fintech infrastructure team needs to set up automated recurring tasks on our backend server. I've attached a requirements document (SCHEDULING-REQUIREMENTS.txt) in the workspace root that lists everything we need — which tasks to schedule, how frequently, which timezone they should run in, which jobs to temporarily suspend for next quarter, and our alerting preferences.

Please set everything up according to that document. Once done, create a file called 'scheduled_jobs_report.json' summarizing what was configured (job IDs, schedule descriptions, statuses, and the alert channel in use). The scheduler stores all its configuration locally and the system has a scheduler tool already available — you'll need to figure out how to use it properly to get everything right.
